title: Average cost of the randomized majority tree
statement: For the specified randomized decision tree computing majority on three signs, when the three input signs are independently uniform in $\{-1,1\}$, the expected number of queried coordinates, also averaged over the tree's seed distribution, is $5/2$.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to a particular randomized tree whose construction is not included in the formal snippet; its average-cost equality is clear, but the tree cannot be characterized more precisely from the provided ground truth.
